full.description: This is a clinical photograph of the oral cavity focusing on the lateral border of the tongue. A prominent ulcerated lesion with raised, indurated borders and surrounding whitish keratotic changes is visible. The clinical appearance of this chronic, indurated ulcer raises high suspicion for malignancy. The most likely diagnosis is squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity.

random.description: This is a clinical photograph of the oral cavity focusing on the lateral border of the tongue. The image displays a prominent, well-demarcated ulcerated lesion with a central yellowish base and a surrounding raised, whitish keratotic border. These clinical features are characteristic of an aphthous ulcer or a traumatic ulceration, though biopsy is often required for definitive diagnosis to rule out malignancy.
